Visualize agent hierarchies — see which agents spawn subagents, track their status, and monitor the full execution tree.

Each spawn is a record of parent agent, child agent and session in the server's SubagentManager: When praisonaiagents is installed, the manager subscribes to its handoff hook, so every agent handoff is recorded (parent, child and session id come from the hook payload; missing values become parent, child and default). Your own code can record spawns with register_spawn(). The tree for a session is built from its spawn records; an agent that is never a child is a root. Records are kept in memory and cleared on restart. Every record has status: "running"; completion is not tracked yet.
Endpoint Method Description /api/subagents GET All spawn records ({"spawns": [...]}) /api/subagents/{session_id} GET Get tree for a session
